name: Quest 1014 'Arugal Must Die' handed in at the Wondrous Wisdomball: the reward buff reaching the ball is the stock rule for any giver (#5795)
contract: quest_template quest 1014 'Arugal Must Die' has RewardSpell 1460 Arcane Intellect, cast by the quest giver on the player at turn-in. Spell 1460's Spell.dbc row (unmodified Blizzard data) targets TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY (21) with TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_PARTY (33) on both aura effects, an area around the caster, and a caster is always in its own party radius. The Wondrous Wisdomball (creature 79025) carries dungeon quests and takes them back, so when it is the giver the buff reaches it exactly as it reaches Dalar Dawnweaver when she is the giver. Expected: the turn-in is accepted, the player gets Arcane Intellect, and the giver, whichever creature it is, is covered by the same cast. This is the stock party-radius rule, not a Wisdomball-specific targeting defect.
